intelligence.enrichment: Forests are large areas with dense growth of various types of plants. They are natural homes for many wild animals, including birds and insects, and provide food and shelter to them. Dense and varied plant growth creates food and shelter, so many animals and other life forms can survive in forests. The learner correctly applies this rule: Forests are large areas with dense growth of various types of plants. They are natural homes for many wild animals, including birds and insects, and provide food and shelter to them. A forest is just many trees grouped together.
